---
title: "Reproduce the finite power-sequence observations"
---

The [versioned example ZIP](../../downloads/sequencing-study-v1.0.zip) contains
59 exact circuit bodies, all scalar observations, compact plotting traces,
saved nominal MOS identities, the original finite plan and small scripts.
The site build reads saved text/figures; it never runs SPICE.

Five figures and the deterministic summary were regenerated byte for byte in
a new directory with a fresh Python environment and a fresh public APM clone.
Four native examples passed there. These illustrations were selected after
the finite block was observed, to cover the input-only current, input
absorption, supply charging peak and supply cycle. They are not a fresh
statistical confirmation subset. See [the actual clean check](clean-public-check.json).

## Environment and commands actually executed

APM v5.0.0 is pinned to commit
`381517fda5107fabf98af7801d5a5103f38e230c`, APM045/VTG. The source is public at
[analog-process-models](https://github.com/ds54e/analog-process-models/tree/v5.0.0).
The tested binary is ngspice 47 at `/usr/local/bin/ngspice`. It was built during
the original preparation; this example does not install or upgrade it. The
native code also accepts `--binary /absolute/path/to/ngspice`.

The following commands were executed with the selected public example files
under `/tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/example`. Use a new directory when repeating
them; existing output destinations are refused. Extract the example ZIP to
obtain those files. Model acquisition is separate from graph generation.

```bash
git -c credential.helper= -c http.extraHeader= clone --branch v5.0.0 https://github.com/ds54e/analog-process-models.git /tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/apm
python3 -m venv /tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/venv
/tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/venv/bin/python -m pip install -r /tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/example/requirements.txt
```

The tested Python was 3.9.25, with NumPy 1.26.4 and Matplotlib 3.9.4.
`requirements.txt` fixes the complete installed package set used here.
With `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1`
in the execution environment, these commands ran:

```bash
/tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/venv/bin/python -B /tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/example/plot.py --data /tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/example/data --output /tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/figures-002
/tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/venv/bin/python -B /tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/example/statistics.py --data /tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/example/data --output /tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/statistics-001.json
/tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/venv/bin/python -B /tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/example/replay.py --apm /tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/apm --case F75L-input_only --output /tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/replay-F75L-input_only-001
/tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/venv/bin/python -B /tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/example/replay.py --apm /tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/apm --case F75L-supply_first-fast-8p --output /tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/replay-F75L-supply_first-fast-8p-001
/tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/venv/bin/python -B /tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/example/replay.py --apm /tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/apm --case R75-input_first-fast-8p --output /tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/replay-R75-input_first-fast-8p-001
/tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/venv/bin/python -B /tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/example/replay.py --apm /tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/apm --case F75L-supply-cycle-8p --output /tmp/adn-sequencing-clean-001/replay-F75L-supply-cycle-8p-001
```

All four replays reproduced every observed OP voltage/current exactly on this
host. The transient checks compare the full time axis, declared source PWL,
output extrema, port-current peaks/energies, plateau entry and capacitor charge.
They preserve the original circuit and raw values; only file bindings move.
No Local sampling, source remapping, trimming, recentering or optimization runs.
The public API's implicit maximum time step equals the explicit frozen value
for these four examples. The tighter numerical refinements are supplied as
saved evidence and exact bodies, and are not advertised as native CLI examples.

The APM API reads actual MOS model, geometry and raw parameters before, during
and after analysis. Public resistor checks use measured voltage/current;
transient capacitance checks use integrated current divided by output-voltage
change. All resistors pass those checks in the three transient examples.
In the DC-only input case, Rbias carries at most 1 pA, so its V/I estimate is
explicitly unresolved; DC also cannot measure an inactive capacitor. The
original private acquisition directly read both element values. The public
replay does not substitute declared values and call them measured.

## Data and measurement identities

[configuration.json](data/configuration.json) binds every exact body, device
UID/W/L/raw realization and source condition. [observations.json](data/observations.json)
retains every native scalar assessment and its attempt hash, including the
four numerical refinements. [manifest.json](data/manifest.json) binds the
compact data; [nominal-audit.json](nominal-audit.json) records the complete
saved-evidence audit. [nominal-plan.json](nominal-plan.json) is the actual
pre-acquisition finite policy, whose original forecast wording is preserved.

The summary verifies input-current identities, port power and all plateau
statuses. The CSV trace is a plotting interpolation; it is not the waveform
used to determine peaks, energies or settling. Settling is the last observed
entry into ±1 mV of an independently observed stationary target through the
fixed horizon. `IN_BAND_AT_FIRST_OBSERVATION` means that no additional
post-ramp delay is resolved. The original raw status/time/bracket is retained
in JSON. `plateaus.csv` normalizes brackets to time after the ramp and leaves
resolved entry-time empty for that status. This display distinction does not
change the frozen measurement or the earlier 0.5-V accuracy criterion.

The complete 59-case block used 277,951,481 bytes of native reports outside Git.
It and its original input/analysis records remain in the private experiment
store with checked local archives. Those archives share the execution host's
physical backing volume and are not off-host protection. The public four-case
route needs none of that private archive.

This check used the same Linux/WSL host in a clean directory. A fresh directory
and public source clone establish the selected input closure, not portability
to every OS or independent scientific replication. Off/near-threshold findings
remain nominal compact-model observations without a new Local statistical
qualification, silicon guarantee, or all-history startup proof.
